method: scripts/iff_chunk_tree_diff_runner.py with scripts/iff_chunk_tree_harness.cpp.in. Retail bytes run under unicorn over a synthetic IFF graph; the candidate port runs under CrossOver.
observation: Eight of nine fixtures agree. The ninth (deep-form-second-child: a FORM holding two children, query 0x4F504531) diverges: retail returns null, the port returns the second child.
cause: Retail 0x00517890 loads [esi+0x10], compares it to 0x464F524D (FORM), then loads [esi+0x14] and compares THAT to the query on both branches (0x005178AB for non-forms, 0x005178B1 for forms). The port instead compares node->tag for non-form chunks and only compares form_type for forms.
consequence: For a chunk whose +0x10 tag differs from its +0x14 field, retail matches on +0x14 and the port matches on +0x10. The fixtures in the runner put the query key in both fields for chunks, which hid the difference until a fixture used distinct values.
status: Unresolved. Both walkers stay STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED. Settling it needs the real on-disk chunk header layout: what +0x10 and +0x14 hold for a plain chunk produced by IffChunkTree_Parse.
also_open: Iff_GetChunkPayload 0x005179C0 returns [chunk+0x1C] unconditionally in retail, while the port returns null for an empty payload vector. And Iff_FindChunk 0x00517940 starts at [form+0x08] in retail, which the harness now mirrors.
